name: Len ngan - Thanh Tung.ogg
title: Audio: “Lên ngàn”, a composition for the đàn bầu (Vietnamese monochord) by Nguyễn Thanh Tùng, uploaded by him as his own work
usage: DanBauClip (slide 13): trimmed 1.7 s to 13.4 s of the 229 s Vorbis file and re-encoded as Opus in WebM, 0.5 s fade at the end. The file page calls it “a special composition for monochord by Nguyen Thanh Tung, a noted Vietnamese monochord performer”. Not checked by ear; checked by analysis — one melodic line of near-pure plucked tones whose pitch slides after the pluck (705 to 797 Hz at 2–4.3 s), as the đàn bầu’s rod bends it.
